prompt: Create a mystical fantasy logo for "MegaDice" - a dice simulator application. **Visual Concept:** Several ornate polyhedral dice (D20 prominent in center, with smaller D12 and D6) floating in magical space. Each die is constructed with elaborate **gold Art Deco frames** featuring geometric circuitry patterns and lines. The faces of each die are **transparent glass panels**. Through the glass, you can see inside each die where **millions of microscopic crystalline dice** are packed together, creating a **swirling prismatic rainbow effect** that glows through the transparent faces. **Dice Details:** - D20 (largest, central), D12, and D6 dice floating at different angles - Each die has ornate golden frames with Art Deco geometric patterns and circuit-like lines - Glass panel faces revealing the interior - Interior filled with millions of tiny microscopic dice (like glittering crystalline sand made of mini polyhedral dice) - The microscopic dice refract light creating intense rainbow chromatic glow emanating through the glass - Some microscopic dice floating out like magical sparkles around the main dice **Art Style - "Fantasy Art Deco Tech":** - Rich, saturated color palette: deep antique golds, royal purples, mystical deep blues, and warm magical amber glows - Art Deco geometric patterns with a magical twist - think 1920s glamour meets arcane magic - Golden filigree and ornamental geometric frames with circuit-like line work - Gilded metallic textures with magical energy accents - Dramatic rim lighting and volumetric glow effects - Dark cosmic or void background to make the glowing elements pop - Rich contrast between dark backgrounds and luminous magical elements - Particle effects and magical sparkles throughout **Lighting & Atmosphere:** - Prismatic rainbow light caustics emanating from within the dice - Golden magical aura surrounding the dice - Magical particles and sparkles floating in space - Warm interior glow from the microscopic dice creating chromatic aberrations **Text Element:** At the bottom, display "MegaDice" in an ornate golden serif typeface with Art Deco styling - elegant, gilded, with decorative flourishes and a slight magical shimmer. **Technical:** High detail fantasy illustration, magical realism, volumetric lighting, rich color saturation, dramatic contrast, 8k quality, suitable for app icon/logo
